name: Sermoneta (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sermoneta (a black eagle on white) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI SERMONETA in yellow beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Sermoneta, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sermoneta arms — black eagle on white, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI SERMONETA beneath the arms
